status: UNMEASURED: generated on the Mac; no frame rendered, nothing downloaded, nothing vendored

generated.licence: project's own (closed-form CIE overcast sky, no third-party pixels)

sources.name: CIE standard overcast sky (Moon & Spencer 1942; ISO 15469:2004 / CIE S 011 type 1)
sources.used_for: sky luminance distribution L = Lz (1 + 2 sin g) / 3 and E = 7 pi Lz / 9

sources.name: ISO 2720 exposure-meter constants (incident C = 250, reflected K = 12.5)
sources.used_for: incident and grey-card EV100; C matches core/scene/beauty_look.py METER_CALIBRATION_C

sources.name: Lagarde & de Rousiers 2014, Moving Frostbite to Physically Based Rendering, sec. 5.1.2
sources.note: unverified against the UE 5.7 source here

sources.name: Bohren 1987, Multiple scattering of light and some of its observable consequences, Am. J. Phys. 55(6)
sources.used_for: two-stream cross-check T = 2 / (2 + tau (1 - g)) on the project's deck fraction; not an input to any light

sources.name: Lekner & Dorf 1988, Why some things are darker when wet, Applied Optics 27(7)
sources.used_for: the direction of the wet-ground albedo factor; the 0.5 itself is visual-only

sources.name: this repository: core/scene/beauty_look.py, core/scene/hero_lighting.py, core/scene/lightning.py, core/sky/plan.py, core/scenario/solar.py
sources.used_for: the calibrated look (EV100 12.5, deck fraction 0.25, meter target 0.40), sun geometry, lightning power; copied as constants and cross-checked by the test
